data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 52–53):** **`إِنَّ`** ka matlab **'Beshak / Yaqeenan'** hai. Jab kisi ism se pehle `إِنَّ` aata hai toh us ism ke aakhri harf ka Pesh (`ـُ`) badal kar **Zabar (`ـَ`)** ho jata hai: `الْكِتَابُ ← إِنَّ الْكِتَابَ`، `اللَّهُ ← إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ`.

data.text: Upar di gayi misaalon se wazeh hai ke Arabi mein 'Inna' (إِنَّ) ka matlab 'Beshak / Yaqeenan' hai. 'Inna' ta'keed ke liye jumle ke shuru mein aata hai. 'Inna' aur iske baad aane wala lafz milkar ek murakkab banaate hain. 'Inna' ke baad aane wale wahid ism par zabar (fatha) aata hai.
